caption: The drawing features a single object centrally positioned on a plain, beige background. The object appears to be an intricately crafted mask or headdress resembling a bird's head. The mask has a large, curved beak colored in brownish-gold with red and dark blue detailing along the lower edge and inside of the beak. The face area above the beak is painted turquoise-green and features a prominent, stylized eye with black and white details. Atop the head are several fluffy white plumes with a few reddish elements that look like feathers or adornments. The back part of the object extends in a mass of grey and white feathers, adding texture and indicating that the mask represents a bird, likely an eagle or similar raptor. The drawing is rendered with realistic shading and delicate attention to the textures of feathers and painted surfaces, and the background contains no additional elements or decoration.
title: Mask
